commands.title: Echo text
commands.desc: Echo msg back with byte length (E11 roundtrip probe)
commands.descForLLM: Read-only channel probe: returns {echo,bytes} for the given msg string. Use it to verify the hub call channel end to end. Safe to retry; no model state touched.

msg.description: text to echo back (UTF-8, any content)

commands.title: Slow sleep
commands.desc: Sleep sec seconds on the Creo main thread (E11-8 timeout honesty)
commands.descForLLM: Test-only blocking probe: sleeps sec seconds ON THE CREO MAIN THREAD, blocking every other hub operation meanwhile. Manifest timeoutSec is 2, so sec=5 demonstrates the 504 report-don't-kill timeout path. Never call in production sessions.

commands.title: Deliberate failure
commands.desc: Always fails with err_code P3_FAIL (E11-7 business-failure envelope)
commands.descForLLM: Always returns ok:false err_code=P3_FAIL - exercises the business-failure envelope and the confirm gate. Takes no arguments; failure is the expected result, do not retry.

commands.title: Create prism feature
commands.desc: Create a 12x10x8 prism import feature in the active part (E11-9 real change)
commands.descForLLM: DESTRUCTIVE model change: creates a real 12x10x8 prism import feature named 'name' in the ACTIVE PART (a part must be open). Not reversible via API - undo only by manual feature delete in Creo. Used to prove PTK change APIs work through the hub main-thread call channel.

commands.title: Async long task (progress demo)
commands.desc: N sleep steps on the Creo main thread; /call returns 202 + jobId (M4b async)
commands.descForLLM: M4b async demo: runs steps x ms sleeping steps ON THE CREO MAIN THREAD and reports progress through the job slot. /call answers 202 {jobId,poll} immediately; poll GET /api/v1/jobs/<id> (or the creo_hub_job tool) for state/pct/result. The main thread stays busy meanwhile - other PTK calls queue. Never call in production sessions.

ms.description: sleep per step in ms (0..1000, default 200)
